records.quote: Arc length is a part of a circle's circumference proportional with its measure
records.claim: Arc length is a part of a circle's circumference proportional with its measure.

records.quote: Where the arc length = The measure of the arc
records.claim: Arc length = (measure of the arc / measure of the circle) × circumference of the circle.
records.formula: $\text{arc length}=\dfrac{\text{measure of the arc}}{\text{measure of the circle}}\times \text{circumference of the circle}$

records.label: Example

records.stem: In the opposite figure: M is a circle with radius length of 5 cm, $m(\widehat{AB})=108^\circ$. Find the length of $\widehat{AB}$ ($\pi=3.14$).
solution: Arc length $=\dfrac{\text{Measure of the arc}}{\text{Measure of the circle}}\times$ circumference of the circle.

records.text: Important corollaries :

records.quote: In the same circle (or in congruent circles), if the measures of arcs
records.claim: Corollary (1): In the same circle (or in congruent circles), if the measures of arcs are equal, then the lengths of the arcs are equal, and conversely.

records.text: If: $m(\overset{\frown}{AB}) = m(\overset{\frown}{CD})$ then: the length of $\overset{\frown}{AB}$ = the length of $\overset{\frown}{CD}$

records.quote: And conversely

records.quote: In the same circle (or in congruent circles), if the measures of
records.claim: Corollary (2): In the same circle (or in congruent circles), if the measures of arcs are equal, then their chords are equal in length, and conversely.

objectives.label: Identify central angles and arcs
objectives.description: Identify a central angle and the minor arc, major arc and semicircle it determines in a circle.

objectives.label: Find the measure of an arc
objectives.description: Find the measure of an arc from its central angle, and find the measure of adjacent arcs by adding or subtracting.

objectives.label: Find arc length
objectives.description: Find the length of an arc as the fraction (arc measure/360°) of the circumference.

objectives.label: Relate equal arcs, lengths and chords
objectives.description: Use the corollaries that equal arc measures give equal arc lengths and equal chords, and the converses, to solve problems.

objectives.label: Use parallel chords and tangents to find equal arcs
objectives.description: Decide that arcs between two parallel chords, or between a chord and a parallel tangent, have equal measures.
